803-3510-3875-8168.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-3510-3875-8168.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each permanent that entered is a Saproling through Arcane Adaptation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Provisioner to trigger.
Resolve a Tireless Provisioner trigger, replacing the artifact token creation with that many 5/5 Dragons through Draconic Visitor.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

2558-4186-6689-6797-8181.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Golbez triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Resolve the Golbez trigger, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-1940-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-1940-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

141-728-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-728-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
141-728-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

730-1479-2841-3318.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Fabled Passage.
730-1479-2841-3318.description:
Fetch a land using Fabled Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Emeria Angel and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Emeria Angel trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature with changeling

4640-6797-8032--201.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with changeling.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Swordsman triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-5147-6351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5147-6351.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Teval.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

2099-2111-3545.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

1479-3257-7893.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2829-6972-7782.easyPrerequisites: You are able to kill Arcbound Ravager such that it won't have a -1/-1 counter on it when it dies.
2829-6972-7782.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Clockwork Hydra.
When Clockwork Hydra dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.
Kill Arcbound Ravager.
When Arcbound Ravager dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Arcbound Ravager from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will have no counters on it due to its modular ability.
Arcbound Ravager dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness
Repeat from step 2.
2829-6972-7782.notes: This combo will end the game in a draw if it isn't interacted with, as it creates a mandatory infinite loop.

215-850-4885.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
215-850-4885.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Overgrown Battlement from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Overgrown Battlement by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1477-1494-3340.easyPrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
1477-1494-3340.description:
Activate five lands by tapping them, creating five Treasure tokens.
Activate Extruder five times by sacrificing five Treasures, putting five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1894-5220-6900-7452.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3000-4659-5086-5183-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
3000-4659-5086-5183-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

4986-5915-6798--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Stickytongue Sentinel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Stickytongue Sentinel enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Stickytongue Sentinel
Repeat.
4986-5915-6798--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

147-3967-7364.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3967-7364.description:
Cast Continue? by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Continue?.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Continue?
Resolve the Continue? copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-3967-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to three additional creatures and return them using Continue? each loop.

413-7124-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
413-7124-7358.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the token dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3817-4050-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand by paying {6}{G}{G} or from your graveyard for its harmonize cost by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Sister Hospitaller and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3129-3899-5295.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

141-5686-6814.description:
Cast Abnormal Endurance by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Abnormal Endurance, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Abnormal Endurance.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Shilgengar abilities from step 5.

1978-2750-4747.notablePrerequisites: You had a creature with power 3 or greater enter the battlefield this turn.
1978-2750-4747.description:
Cause Alena to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Alena.
Repeat from step 2.

3054-3416-5332-5670.easyPrerequisites:
You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
3054-3416-5332-5670.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once, sacrificing the Vampire token instead.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2104-6122-6927.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Damage Control Crew by paying its mana cost.
When Damage Control Crew enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Damage Control Crew from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

431-851-2557-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-2557-6441.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

585-2364-3767-3918.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Mana Vault's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

1495-2474-4613-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting three +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and City on Fire.
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1796-2921-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
1796-2921-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
1796-2921-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1744-2743-6570.description:
Cast Mnemonic Deluge by paying {6}{U}{U}{U}, exiling Rite of Replication and casting three copies of it without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the three Rite of Replication copies, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2034-2770-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Donate.
2034-2770-5434-5555.description:
Cast Donate by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a face-down creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 2.

2099-2558-5687-5692.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Weapons Trainer, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

413-3197-5445.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Herd Baloth.
413-3197-5445.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
413-3197-5445.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Beast.
When the Beast dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 4.

313-914-4050.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
313-914-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {B}.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

2092-4050-4385.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
2092-4050-4385.description:
Activate Silver Queen by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Sliver, adding {1}.
Repeat.

366-1218-3433.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Purphoros +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Cast Hornet Queen by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Hornet Queen enters the battlefield, it and Purphoros trigger.
Resolve the Hornet Queen trigger, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
When the Insects enter the battlefield, Purphoros triggers four times.
Resolve all Purphoros triggers, causing each opponent to get ten poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

738-1646-2364-4647-4659.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls a creature with toughness equal to one.
738-1646-2364-4647-4659.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Acorn Catapult by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting a creature an opponent controls with toughness equal to one.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing Mana Vault and Acorn Catapult, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Acorn Catapult ability, dealing 1 damage to the creature, causing it to die due to having zero toughness, and causing its controller to create a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the opponent's creature dies, Glissa triggers twice, returning Acorn Catapult and Mana Vault from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Acorn Catapult and Mana Vault by paying {5}.
Repeat.

4050-4351-5003.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four creature cards in your graveyard.
4050-4351-5003.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hallowed Spiritkeeper, adding {1}.
Hallowed Spiritkeeper dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Hallowed Spiritkeeper trigger, creating at least four 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Spirits, adding {3}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Hallowed Spiritkeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
